assessment: In this important study, the authors have generated a large collection of nanobodies against Drosophila muscle components, showing their interest to define the molecular organisation of muscle sarcomeres. Moreover, they show that nanobody expression in muscles can block the normal function of those proteins. While the use of nanobodies to reveal the distribution of proteins as such is not novel, their use in a model organism is novel and their demonstration of their usefulness is compelling. Beyond Drosophila and muscles their work can emulate similar strategies for other tissues in other species.
